title: 88 ## Juvenile Delinquency under Local & Special laws 5.2 A total of 73,391 offences involving juveniles were recorded in 1983 under the Local & Special Laws against 84,777 offences in 1982 registering a decline of 13.5 per cent in 1983 over 1982. The largest contribution to the total was from offences under the Prohibition Act (21,371) and Gambling Act (13,405). The offences under Arms Act, 'Explosives & Explosive Substances Act', 'S.I.T. Act' and 'Prevention of Corruption Act' recorded an increase in 1983 over 1982, while the offences under 'Opium Act', 'Gambling Act', 'Excise Act', 'Prohibition Act', 'Motor Vehicle Act' and 'Indian Railways Act', registered a decline during 1983 over 1982. Offences under 'Gambling Act' and 'Prohibition Act' taken together accounted for 47.4 per cent of the total offences under Local & Special Laws while no case was registered under Customs Act:
